name: Utah 4-H Teen Winter Retreat
what_you_do: A weekend retreat. It has workshops on how to talk with people and have healthy friendships. It has winter fun like snowshoeing and skiing. College 4-H members speak on a panel.
who_can_apply: Utah teens in grades 9 to 12. A waiver must be uploaded in Zsuite when you register.
pay_detail: $135 per person. Includes lodging, meals and activities.
duration: Friday 4 PM to Saturday 3 PM (Jan 22 to 23, 2027)
deadline_text: Registration Nov 1 to Jan 8, or until filled.
how_to_apply: Sign up through Zsuite and upload the signed waiver. Teens in grades 10 to 12 can also apply to the Teen Winter Retreat Design Team, which has 8 spots. Apply by Oct 24 with a 4-H portfolio, which is a resume and cover letter, and short answers.
notes: Design Team applications are open Sept 1 to Oct 24 and let teens plan activities and teach workshops. Questions: Utah 4-H State Office, 435-797-4444.
